title: Diabetes Prediction Research — AIMS Lab
summary: A student research project on predicting undiagnosed diabetes from a sparse, label-scarce community health screening dataset, comparing imputation, class-imbalance, PU-learning, and modern ML methods. Its v3 notebook imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic minority-class samples for diabetes prediction, running SDV's CTGAN synthesizer directly for tabular data augmentation.
